youtube_short.title: Your New House Has a $14K Hidden Bill
title_alternatives: The $14,000 Surprise Nobody Warns First-Time Buyers About
Why Your Mortgage Is the Cheapest Part of Owning a Home
youtube_short.description: Think your mortgage is your biggest housing expense? It's not even close. Between the 1% maintenance rule, property taxes, insurance, and year-one surprise repairs, a $400K home actually costs $3,500 a month — not $2,100. 77% of first-year homeowners get hit with an unexpected repair averaging $5,400. Before you buy, stash $15K beyond your down payment. Follow for more money truths your agent skipped. #homebuying #firsttimehomebuyer #realestate #hiddencosts #personalfinance
